jobs.title: Senior Contract & Claims Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Head of Controlling and Contract Management PAPI Switzerland

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to set out the strategy in consultation with the business and other functions for the provision of contract management services within your assigned area of responsibility focusing on execution. You will ensure that all contract management activities are executed in accordance with corporate/division/business policies and procedures, Contract Management Policy, Contract Management Framework, and established contract management and risk management practices, with a focus on risk mitigation and opportunity maximization.
You will take a holistic and solution orientated approach to contract management, with a cross-border, cross-business line, and cross-division perspective, while promoting collaboration and a broader, common interests attitude to reaching objectives.


The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid (min. office presence of 60% if based in Switzerland)


This role is contributing to the Process Industries Division. Main stakeholders are Sales, Operations, Procurement, Legal and Integrity, Trade Compliance, HSE, Controlling and Commercial Management.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Ensuring that the portfolio of contract management services within the assigned area of responsibility follow contract and claim management methodologies in accordance with Contract Management Framework, best practices for contract and risk management and relevant policies and procedures.
  • Analyzing the contract terms to highlight, flag and address the areas of potential opportunity and risk, such as ambiguities, omissions, and conflicts, throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Developing contract management strategy in line with ABB’s policies and procedures, customer requirements, and the overall execution strategy, considering the risk, pricing, scope, and schedule.
  • Enforcing and defending ABB's contractual interests against customers and suppliers throughout the project lifecycle, including monitoring and assessment of changes and deviations, as well as defending and enforcing commercial claims.



• Qualifications for the role:

  • A Senior Contract & Claims Manager with a business and commercially driven, pragmatic mindset who can act as a bridge with various stakeholders and interested parties, understanding that good results are achieved through solution-oriented collaboration.
  • A flare for contract and risk management.
  • Degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Business Administration, Contract Management or in any related field, plus a minimum of 10 years’ experience in international contract management in the field of systems delivery for industrial customers or suppliers.
  • Proficient oral and written English and Spanish fluency is required. Other languages such as German are a strong plus.
  • Willingness to travel to customer meetings and to ABB offices.


More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-​specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

The recruiting process is being led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Senior Project Lead Engineer - Power Systems (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Power Systems Engineering Manager

__

As a Project Engineer in Power Systems at ABB, a global leader in technology, electrification, automation, and digitalization, you will be part of a dynamic international project team, playing a crucial role in providing innovative technical solutions for our clients.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead technical activities in international projects across the full project lifecycle, covering electrification, control, and instrumentation for industrial plants. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated engineering solutions.
  • Ensure the integration of all engineering disciplines and efficient execution in line with contract specifications, quality and technical standards, safety requirements, and product compliance. Provide technical guidance on engineered High Voltage (HV) and Medium Voltage (MV) power distribution equipment and electrical studies.
  • Contribute actively to design reviews, monitor the development of project deliverables, and support the preparation of claims and change requests, including new scopes of work, cost and schedule impacts, and related risk assessments.
  • Engage proactively with internal and external stakeholders, including customers and equipment suppliers, from procurement through delivery to ensure equipment meets project requirements.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, with a focus on power distribution or a related field.
  • More than 12+ years of experience in power systems, ideally as a Lead Engineer or Senior Project Engineer.
  • Strong knowledge of power distribution concepts and the sizing and specification of primary and secondary equipment. Proven experience in advanced electrical network analysis and simulation, including load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, harmonic analysis, transient and dynamic stability studies, small-signal and large-signal stability assessments, EMT simulations, power quality analysis, and grid compliance evaluations for industrial, mining, and renewable energy applications. Experience with HV, MV and LV equipment, digital protection relays, and IEC 61850 engineering.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset and strong written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Highly self-motivated and curious, with a strong interest in learning and applying new technologies.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel internationally approximately 25% of the time.

More about us

GREAT MINDS, GREAT MINES

From cellphones, electric vehicles, batteries, wind farms…virtually every aspect of modern life relies on the ores mined from the earth. But there must be a transformation. The demand for minerals has increased significantly, making sustainable, safe, and productive mining more crucial than ever.

Combining our advanced portfolio of electrification, automation, and digital technologies with over 130 years of experience in the mining industry, ABB is at the forefront of this transformation journey with our holistic framework eMine™

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). This recruiting is led by Ceren Oezen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Power Systems Engineering Manager

Als Project Engineer in Power Systems bei ABB, einem weltweit führenden Unternehmen in den Bereichen Technologie, Elektrifizierung, Automatisierung und Digitalisierung, werden Sie Teil eines dynamischen internationalen Projektteams sein, das eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Bereitstellung innovativer technischer Lösungen für unsere Kunden spielt.

Das Arbeitsmodell für diese Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Diese Rolle trägt zur Division Process Industries in der Schweiz bei.

>Diese Rolle trägt zur Division Process Industries in der Schweiz bei. Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Führen Sie technische Aktivitäten in internationalen Projekten über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg, einschließlich Elektrifizierung, Steuerung und Instrumentierung für Industrieanlagen. Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um integrierte Engineering-Lösungen zu liefern.
  • Gewährleistung der Integration aller Engineering-Disziplinen und einer effizienten Ausführung gemäß den Vertragsspezifikationen, Qualitäts- und technischen Standards, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Produktkonformität. Geben Sie technische Anleitung zu technischen Hochspannungs- (HV) und Mittelspannungs- (MV) Stromverteilungsgeräten und elektrischen Studien.
  • Tragen Sie aktiv zu Design-Reviews bei, überwachen Sie die Entwicklung von Projektergebnissen und unterstützen Sie die Erstellung von Ansprüchen und Änderungswünschen, einschließlich neuer Arbeitsbereiche, Kosten- und Zeitplanauswirkungen und damit verbundener Risikobewertungen.
  • Engagieren Sie sich proaktiv mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kunden und Ausrüstungslieferanten, von der Beschaffung bis zur Lieferung, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ausrüstung die Projektanforderungen erfüllt.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, mit Schwerpunkt auf Energieverteilung oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • Mehr als 12+ Jahre Erfahrung in Energiesystemen, idealerweise als Lead Engineer oder Senior Project Engineer.
  • Ein fundiertes Wissen über Energieverteilungskonzepte und die Dimensionierung und Spezifikation von Primär- und Sekundärgeräten. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der fortgeschrittenen Analyse und Simulation elektrischer Netze, einschließlich Lastfluss, Kurzschluss, Schutzkoordinierung, Oberwellenanalyse, transiente und dynamische Stabilitätsstudien, Stabilitätsbewertungen für Kleinsignale und Großsignale, EMT-Simulationen, Analyse der Stromqualität und Bewertung der Netzkonformität für Anwendungen in den Bereichen Industrie, Bergbau und erneuerbare Energien. Erfahrung mit HV-, MV- und LV-Geräten, digitalen Schutzrelais und IEC 61850 Engineering.
  • Demonstrierte Führungsqualitäten, mit einer kollaborativen, lösungsorientierten Denkweise und starken schriftlichen und verbalen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Sehr selbstmotiviert und neugierig, mit einem starken Interesse am Lernen und der Anwendung neuer Technologien.
  • Fluent in Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
  • Reisebereitschaft international ca. 25% der Zeit.

Mehr über uns

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Team Leader

__

In this position, you will perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure excellent customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and executing them in line with customer requirements and expectations. Through your clear and professional communication, you will contribute to customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing transparent information regarding schedules, processes, and expectations.


Work model: Field-based


This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Your key stakeholders will include customers, field service colleagues, and the internal service coordination team.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborate with customers on-site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges
  • Perform service assignments, identify technical issues, and conduct on-site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified
  • Prepare material lists for service assignments and ensure that all required materials, spare parts, and tools are available, complete, and in proper working condition
  • Provide training to field service colleagues and customers as required

Our team


You will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.



Your qualifications


  • Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electrical Planner, or a comparable technical qualification
  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage
  • Solid knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and service processes in an industrial environment
  • Strong customer focus, flexibility in adapting to changing requirements, and a solution-oriented and collaborative approach to teamwork
  • Fluent German and basic English skills for professional communication with customers
  • Willingness to travel, participate in an on-call rotation, and occasionally work weekends; primary service area: Region Central Switzerland
  • Valid driver's license for assignments within Switzerland


In dieser Position führen Sie Servicearbeiten gemäss den Arbeitsanweisungen sowie den Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien von ABB durch. Sie stellen täglich einen ausgezeichneten Kundenservice sicher, indem Sie Serviceeinsätze planen und diese entsprechend den • Anforderungen und Erwartungen der Kunden ausführen. Durch Ihre klare und professionelle Kommunikation tragen Sie zur Kundenzufriedenheit und Kundenbindung bei, indem Sie transparente Informationen zu Zeitplänen, Abläufen und Erwartungen vermitteln.


Arbeitsmodell: Aussendienst


Diese Position ist Teil der Division Electrification, Smart Power in Baden. Zu Ihren wichtigsten Ansprechpartnern gehören Kunden, Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie das interne Service-Koordinationsteam.


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden vor Ort, um Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und bestehende Herausforderungen zu lösen
  • Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen, Identifizierung technischer Probleme sowie Durchführung von Analysen vor Ort oder aus der Ferne innerhalb der Servicekategorien und Produktbereiche, für die Sie zertifiziert sind
  • Erstellung von Materiallisten für Serviceeinsätze und Sicherstellung, dass alle erforderlichen Materialien, Ersatzteile und Werkzeuge vollständig verfügbar und in einwandfreiem Zustand sind
  • Durchführung von Schulungen für Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie für Kunden nach Bedarf


Unser Team
Sie werden Teil eines kollegialen und unterstützenden Teams, in dem Sie sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln können.

• Ihre Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automatiker/in, Elektriker/in, Elektroinstallateur/in, Elektroplaner/in oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; Erfahrung mit USV-Anlagen (unterbrechungsfreie Stromversorgung) ist von Vorteil
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in elektromechanischen Systemen, Diagnosetools und Serviceprozessen im industriellen Umfeld
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Flexibilität bei wechselnden • Anforderungen sowie eine lösungsorientierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kunden
  • Reisebereitschaft, Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme am Pikettdienst sowie zu gelegentlichen Wochenendeinsätzen; primäres Servicegebiet: Region Zentralschweiz
  • Gültiger Führerausweis für Einsätze innerhalb der Schweiz


Benefits


• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)
  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities
  • Company vehicle and attractive fleet discounts
  • Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)
  • REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

More about us


ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, critical infrastructure, and commercial buildings. The division's technical teams work closely with industry partners to develop innovative solutions that support growth, the energy transition, and sustainability goals.

Its portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting solutions, and safety devices such as switches and relays. The Power Protection business supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced and energy-efficient UPS solutions. In addition, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable and user-friendly platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO₂ emissions.


The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Engineering Manager

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a sales environment by supporting initiatives focused on data understanding, structuring, analysis, and automation. You will work closely with the sales team to understand how commercial and technical information is generated, stored, and used across different systems, and help identify opportunities to improve efficiency through digitalization and automation.

The work model for the role is: #-LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing data sources used by the sales organization, including offer documentation, SharePoint repositories, internal sales tools, and CRM systems such as Salesforce.

  • Understanding how commercial, pricing, business, and technical information is created, managed, and used across the sales process.

  • Identifying opportunities to structure data more effectively and support the development of automated workflows, dashboards, or analytical modules to improve team efficiency.

  • Collaborating with sales and other relevant stakeholders to document current practices, propose improvements, and support implementation of data-driven solutions.


• Qualifications for the role

  • You are currently pursuing, or have recently completed, a Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • You have strong interest in data analysis, artificial intelligence, automation, and the optimization of business processes through digital solutions.

  • You have practical knowledge of programming and data handling tools, preferably Python; familiarity with C#, databases, or API-based integrations is a plus.

  • You are comfortable working with large and unstructured datasets from different business systems and translating them into structured insights and improvement ideas.

  • You have an analytical mindset and enjoy understanding how information flows through business processes, from generation to reporting and decision-making.

  • You communicate clearly in English; additional language skills such as German are a plus.

  • You hold a valid work permit for Switzerland or are eligible to work in Switzerland.

More about us

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry- specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

This recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Marketing & Sales Manager

style="text-align:inherit !important">

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

>In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen in einer Vertriebsumgebung zu sammeln, indem Sie Initiativen unterstützen, die sich auf Datenverständnis, Strukturierung, Analyse und Automatisierung konzentrieren. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Vertriebsteam zusammen, um zu verstehen, wie kommerzielle und technische Informationen über verschiedene Systeme hinweg generiert, gespeichert und verwendet werden, und helfen, Möglichkeiten zur Effizienzsteigerung durch Digitalisierung und Automatisierung zu identifizieren.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #-LI-Hybrid

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Analyse von Datenquellen, die von der Vertriebsorganisation verwendet werden, einschließlich Angebotsdokumentation, SharePoint-Repositories, internen Vertriebstools und CRM-Systemen wie Salesforce.

  • Understanding how commercial, pricing, business, and technical information are created, managed and used across the sales process.

  • Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten, Daten effektiver zu strukturieren und die Entwicklung automatisierter Workflows, Dashboards oder Analysemodule zur Verbesserung der Teameffizienz zu unterstützen.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb und anderen relevanten Stakeholdern, um aktuelle Praktiken zu dokumentieren, Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen und die Implementierung datengesteuerter Lösungen zu unterstützen.


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Sie verfolgen derzeit oder haben kürzlich einen Master-Abschluss in Data Science, Informatik, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Statistik, Business Analytics, Informationssystemen oder einem verwandten Bereich abgeschlossen.

  • Sie haben großes Interesse an Datenanalyse, künstlicher Intelligenz, Automatisierung und der Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen durch digitale Lösungen.

  • Sie haben praktische Kenntnisse in Programmier- und Datenverarbeitungstools, vorzugsweise Python; Vertrautheit mit C#, Datenbanken oder API-basierten Integrationen ist ein Plus.

  • Sie arbeiten gerne mit großen und unstrukturierten Datensätzen aus verschiedenen Geschäftssystemen und übersetzen diese in strukturierte Erkenntnisse und Verbesserungsideen.

  • Sie haben eine analytische Denkweise und genießen es zu verstehen, wie Informationen durch Geschäftsprozesse fließen, von der Generation bis zur Berichterstattung und Entscheidungsfindung.

  • Du kommunizierst klar auf Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse wie Deutsch sind ein Plus.

  • Sie besitzen eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für die Schweiz oder sind berechtigt, in der Schweiz zu arbeiten.

Mehr über uns

Die Division Process Industries bietet komplette Elektrifizierungs- und Automatisierungslösungen, branchenspezifische Produkte und Lifecycle-Services in allen Branchen. Das Verständnis und die Bewältigung von Herausforderungen und Chancen erfordern ein tiefes Fachwissen. Engineering und Lieferung von Automatisierungslösungen vom Gerät bis zur Überwachung und Steuerung machen unsere Kunden mehr aus ihrer Investition. Digitalisierungslösungen einschließlich kollaborativer Operationen und Augmented Reality helfen, die Produktivität von Anlagen und Unternehmen zu verbessern, Wartungs- und Energiekosten zu senken. Unser Engineering-, Projektmanagement-, Service- und Lösungsportfolio deckt eine breite Palette von Branchen ab - Zellstoff, Papier & Fasern, Bergbau, Getriebelose Mühlenantriebe (GMDs), Hebezeuge, Metalle, Wachstumsbranchen wie Zement, Lebensmittel & Getränke, Rechenzentrumsautomatisierung, Hochleistungsgleichrichter und Batterien.

Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani verwaltet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire de la commercialisation et des ventes

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion d'acquérir une expérience pratique dans un environnement de vente en appuyant des initiatives axées sur la compréhension, la structuration, l'analyse et l'automatisation des données. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale pour comprendre comment l'information commerciale et technique est générée, stockée et utilisée dans différents systèmes, et aider à identifier les occasions d'améliorer l'efficacité par la numérisation et l'automatisation.

  • Comprendre comment l'information commerciale, tarifaire, commerciale et technique est créée, gérée et utilisée tout au long du processus de vente.

  • Déterminer les possibilités de structurer les données plus efficacement et appuyer l'élaboration de workflows automatisés, de tableaux de bord ou de modules analytiques pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe.

  • Collaborer avec les ventes et d'autres intervenants pertinents pour documenter les pratiques actuelles, proposer des améliorations et appuyer la mise en oeuvre de solutions fondées sur les données.


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Vous poursuivez ou avez terminé récemment une maîtrise en sciences des données, en informatique, en intelligence artificielle, en statistique, en analyse des affaires, en systèmes d'information ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Vous vous intéressez beaucoup à l'analyse des données, à l'intelligence artificielle, à l'automatisation et à l'optimisation des processus opérationnels grâce à des solutions numériques.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler avec des ensembles de données larges et non structurés provenant de différents systèmes d'affaires et de les traduire en idées d'amélioration et d'idées structurées.

  • Vous avez un état d'esprit analytique et vous comprenez comment l'information circule dans les processus opérationnels, de la génération à la production de rapports et à la prise de décisions.

  • Vous communiquez clairement en anglais; d'autres compétences linguistiques comme l'allemand sont un plus.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Engineering Manager - GMD

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will ensure the effective delivery of the Service portfolio according to ABB's standard processes and safety guidelines, ensuring customer satisfaction. Each day, you will provide technical support, act as a specialist, and solve problems within your area of expertise. You will also leverage your expertise by proactively communicating with both customers and ABB service sales and life cycle management teams to understand customer needs and capitalize on business opportunities for service growth. The role includes on-site assignments up to 40% of the time.

The work model for the role is: LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Business Line Mining & Materials in a global leadership role for the anchor product GMD (Gearless Mill Drive). Main stakeholders include customers, internal service sales and life cycle management teams, and other engineering disciplines.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Providing technical support and solving problems via remote or on-site service, including installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, trouble shooting, back-office engineering and consulting, retrofit engineering, etc.

  • Investigating customer needs through professional consulting. Additionally, managing customer relationships and maintaining regular contact with key customers and acting as 24/7 support line for one complete week, approx. every two months, depending on availability.

  • Proactively suggesting product and quality improvements and communicating them within the ABB organization.

  • Providing technical consulting on Service solutions to management and customers. You will join a truly international and dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering or any related field.

  • Proven experience as an electrical engineer, product specialist or in a similar technical role, preferably within the power electronics sector.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with effective communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling seamless collaboration across departments and with customers.

  • Attention to detail, ensuring product conformity, accurate technical documentation, and adherence to quality standard.

  • Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in other languages such as Spanish is a plus.

More about us

GREAT MINDS, GREAT MINES From cellphones, electric vehicles, batteries, wind farms…virtually every aspect of modern life relies on the ores mined from the earth. But there must be a transformation. ABB’s GMD is the most powerful mill drive system in the market to power semi autogenous (SAG), ball and autogenous (AG) mills. This ’workhorse’ for grinding operations combines a robust, service-friendly, and fit-for-purpose design to provide the highest throughput, reliability, and availability for your processing plant.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

  • Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Begeisterung für die Analyse und Auswahl von Geschäftsstrategien sowie die Entwicklung kundenorientierter Lösungen.

  • Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Zuverlässigkeit und ausgeprägter beruflicher Integrität.

​

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this position, you will play a key role in ABB’s medium-voltage solutions business process. You will work closely with sales teams, suppliers, and customers throughout the consultation and tendering phases.

You will contribute directly to the quality and competitiveness of our proposals by combining technical expertise, commercial insight, and execution excellence.

Work model: Hybrid

This role actively contributes to the development of the installed medium-voltage base at our customers within the Distribution Solutions division of ABB Electrification in Switzerland.

Your Key • Responsibilities

  • Coordinate quotation requests and ensure compliance with deadlines throughout the entire tendering and proposal process.

  • Analyze specifications, technical requirements, and customer needs from both technical and commercial perspectives, and select the most suitable solutions and products based on customer requirements and the available solution portfolio.

  • Perform cost calculations and prepare structured technical and commercial proposal documentation, including product descriptions, services, and deliverables.

  • Independent, flexible, and customer-oriented way of working.

  • Excellent communication skills in German and a good command of English, both written and spoken.

  • Passion for analyzing and selecting business strategies and developing customer-focused solutions.

  • Interest in cost calculations and the preparation of technical proposals and quotations.

  • Team-oriented personality with a reliable work ethic and a high level of professional integrity.

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will be responsible for driving front end sales for large and strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a full-scope solution provider across the mining value chain. You will lead sales activities for complex international opportunities, covering the broader ABB portfolio in electrification, automation, drives and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to AUPI in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Global Accounts, EPCMs and key Local Business Lines within AUPI.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Driving the sales of strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a global solution provider.
  • Promoting and selling the full ABB portfolio for mining, including high voltage, medium voltage, low voltage, variable frequency drives, electrification, automation and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio, including GMDs, RMDs and related applications.
  • Leading front-end sales activities for large, international mining opportunities with multiple stakeholders.
  • Managing capture teams and coordinating multinational and cross-functional resources towards a winning strategy.
  • Developing and executing account and opportunity strategies in close collaboration with account managers, OEMs, EPCMs and local ABB units.
  • Ensuring ABB’s value proposition is clearly communicated and professionally presented to customers and stakeholders.
  • Leading strategic discussions related to scope allocation and division of responsibilities between global and local units.
  • Building, qualifying and developing a strong pipeline of mining opportunities to support sustainable growth.

Our team dynamics

You will join a talented, high-performing and internationally connected team, where collaboration, business insight and customer focus are key to success.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 12 years of experience in the mining industry or similar, with a strong track record in sales or execution of complex industrial solutions.
  • Proven front-end sales leadership with capture team ownership in large strategic mining projects.
  • Specialist expertise in electrification, variable frequency drives, gearless drive systems and multi-megawatt power solutions.
  • Multi-megawatt drive systems experience; account strategy with EPCMs and OEMs.
  • Process-level understanding as mine owner's representative.
  • Established relationships with major mining accounts, major mine operators and EPCMs; technical authority in the market
  • Bachelor of Electrical & Electronics Engineering
  • Proven capture team leadership across 15+ countries; Solid writing and speaking skills in English & Spanish.

What’s in it for you?

  • Opportunity to shape ABB’s position in some of the world’s largest mining projects.
  • Exposure to global customers, EPCMs and ABB stakeholders across multiple countries.
  • A highly visible role with strategic impact on business growth.
  • The chance to work in an international environment with experienced sales and execution professionals.

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-​specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead a regional service team with diverse expertise in service planning, order processing, and service execution within the Electrification business area. Together with your team, you will ensure comprehensive customer support for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems across the German-speaking region of Switzerland.


Reporting directly to the Head of Service UPS Systems, you will make a significant contribution to the implementation of the service strategy and the promotion of business growth. Through efficient planning and targeted allocation of resources, while ensuring compliance with established processes, procedures, and guidelines, you will drive high service quality and operational excellence.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading, coaching, and developing a regional service team consisting of Service Coordinators, Order Handling Specialists, Technical Support Engineers, and Field Service Technicians, while fostering a motivating, safe, and performance-oriented work environment.
  • Taking overall responsibility for all service activities, customer orders, and maintenance operations within the region, ensuring the achievement of quality, performance, and commercial targets, maintaining customer relationships, and delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Providing operational support to the team (approximately 60% of the role) in service planning (FSL), including the review and approval of weekly reports and expense claims.
  • Ensuring the implementation of and compliance with all occupational health and safety requirements.


Your • Qualifications

  • Technical vocational training in Electrical Engineering, complemented by a job-related advanced qualification at Higher Technical College level (e.g., Certified Technician, Master Craftsman, or equivalent).
  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in the maintenance, servicing, commissioning, and repair of electrical installations.
  • Experience with power electronics and/or UPS systems.
  • Several years of leadership experience in a similar position.
  • A flexible and resilient personality with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A structured and solution-oriented approach to work and problem-solving.
  • Willingness to travel throughout Switzerland.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications as well as SAP or other ERP systems.
  • Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; French and Italian are an advantage.


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credits
  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs
  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)


More About Us

ABB’s Service Division partners with customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The division’s comprehensive service portfolio includes product care, modernization, and consulting services designed to enhance performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help our customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, maximize the value derived from them, and recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of their lifecycle.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
